def left_rotate(n, d):
    # Calculate the number of bits to rotate by considering modulo 32
    bit_size = 32
    d = d % bit_size
    
    # Perform rotation
    left = n << d
    right = n >> (bit_size - d)
    
    # Combine both parts and return
    result = (left | right) & ((1 << bit_size) - 1)
    return result
